notes: Defined 5 stories covering schema, logic, API, tests, and integration for consent framework bug fixes.

MAINT-CONSENT-S1.title: Consent Schema and Tier Contract Validation
MAINT-CONSENT-S1.description: Audit and fix inconsistencies in consent data schema across Tier 1 (basic) and Tier 2 (HIPAA) flows, ensuring strict validation, required fields, and backward compatibility with existing stored records.

MAINT-CONSENT-S2.title: Core Consent Logic Edge Case Handling
MAINT-CONSENT-S2.description: Fix defects in ConsentService for edge cases including partial consent transitions, revoked consent, repeated submissions, and improper tier escalation or downgrade handling.

MAINT-CONSENT-S3.title: Consent API Contract and Tool Router Alignment
MAINT-CONSENT-S3.description: Ensure consent-related endpoints and tool interactions enforce correct tier gating, input validation, and error handling, aligning Tool Router behavior with updated consent logic.

MAINT-CONSENT-S4.title: Consent Flow Unit and Integration Test Suite
MAINT-CONSENT-S4.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests covering two-tier consent flow, edge cases, failure modes, and regression scenarios identified in QA and UAT.

MAINT-CONSENT-S5.title: Lead Capture and Consent Integration Fixes
MAINT-CONSENT-S5.description: Resolve integration issues between LeadService and ConsentService, ensuring correct persistence of consent tier, prevention of duplicate records, and proper enforcement of Tier 2 requirements before lead creation.
